questions.stem: There are flowers on ____ sides of the road.

options.distractor: neither 表否定，且接单数名词

questions.explanation: 路有两边，sides 是复数 → both。

questions.stem: — Can I have some more bread? — Sorry, there is ____ left.

options.distractor: both 表肯定且用于两者
either 表“任一”，与 sorry 矛盾

questions.explanation: bread 不可数、没有剩余 → none。

questions.stem: ____ of the two answers is correct. Think again.

options.distractor: both 作主语谓语用复数 are

questions.explanation: 两个答案都不对 → Neither，谓语用单数 is。

questions.stem: — When shall we meet, Saturday or Sunday? — ____ day is OK. I'm free.

options.distractor: both 后面要接复数 days，谓语用 are
none 不用于两者，也不接 day

questions.explanation: 两天中任一天都行，day 是单数 → Either。

options.text: Each of the students has a new book.
Both Tom and Jim are from England.
All of the money are spent.
None of us knows his address.

questions.explanation: money 不可数，all of the money 按单数处理，谓语用 is。

questions.stem: — Are the two boys both from Class 3? — No. ____ of them is in Class 3.

options.distractor: either 表示“有一个是”，与 No 不符
both 作主语谓语用 are，且表肯定

questions.explanation: 两个人都不是 → Neither，谓语用 is。
